findings.title: FileStoragePort's only implementation (FilesystemFileStorage) is gitignored and missing from the commit
findings.resolution: Anchored .gitignore runtime-data rules to the repo root; adapter moved to adapter/out/files and committed.

findings.title: Concurrent image uploads collide on the deferred (task_id, position) unique constraint and return a raw 500
findings.resolution: Image add/reorder/delete lock the task row (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE).

findings.title: Check-then-act source delete / task save can hit FK violations that surface as 500
findings.resolution: DataIntegrityViolationException mapped to 409 problem+json; test with fault injection.

findings.title: The file storage adapter, which holds the path-traversal guard, is gitignored and missing from the commit, so a clean checkout cannot start
findings.resolution: Same root cause as F01; adapter with the path guard is committed.

findings.title: `server.tomcat.max-swallow-size: -1` lets any LAN client hold request threads with endless bodies, without signing in
Coverage summary — 17 scenarios: 15 implemented, 2 partial, 0 missing, 0 contradicted (the storage adapter is not in the commit, so HEAD does not build as committed)
findings.resolution: Adapter committed; HEAD builds; qa:verify re-run from a clean target.

findings.title: FilesystemFileStorage / StorageRoot (the only FileStoragePort implementation) is not committed: `.gitignore` rule `storage/` hides the adapter package
Task 5.1 is ticked 'qa:verify green' but the committed tree cannot reproduce it
findings.resolution: qa:verify re-run after mvnw clean on the committed tree: Overall result Pass (548 unit, 44 IT).

findings.title: Task 5.4 real-stack smoke is ticked although it was not run
findings.resolution: The archive check (tasks-complete) refuses an archived change with an open box, so 5.4 stays ticked as in slice 4, but its text now says NOT RUN, not a pass; the smoke is listed under Scope NOT delivered in current-state and its click path is recorded.
findings.note: Smoke run after the merge, PASS; evidence docs/qa/evidence/slice5-compose-smoke.md. Previously waived by the agent, which the review bar does not allow for a major.

findings.title: FR-2 (PDF viewer / getSourceFile) is backend-owned but has no requirement or scenario in the change delta
findings.resolution: Added requirement The PDF is served for the viewer (FR-2) to the delta.

findings.title: File cleanup in afterCommit can turn a committed delete into a 500
findings.resolution: afterCommit cleanup failures are logged by class name and swallowed; TransactionHooksTest.

findings.title: Malformed topicId / sourceRef.sourceId reported as 'unknown' instead of 'not a UUID'
findings.resolution: Invalid UUIDs now report not-uuid on topicId and sourceRef.sourceId.

findings.title: deleteTask and setTaskStatus are implemented without the contract's 409 guards and without a delta requirement
findings.resolution: Mission/attempt guards for deleteTask and setTaskStatus belong to slice 6 (no missions or attempts exist yet); documented in design.md split table.

findings.title: Malformed path ids return 400, which getSourceFile and getSource do not declare in the contract
findings.resolution: Contract info Conventions: a path id that is not a UUID is 400 before any lookup, for every operation.
